' ===== Sonnenfeld Solar - website logic (VB-style) =====
' Everything on this page that moves is driven by this code:
'   - the bar chart on the canvas (cvChart) and the counters Stat1..Stat4
'   - the solar calculator (sldArea, cboRegion, chkBattery)
'   - the testimonial slider, the service search and the team filter
' The components talk to the page through events: Svc1_Selected, Faq1_Opened, ContactForm1_Submitted.

Dim ticks As Integer
Dim grow As Double
Dim hot As Integer
Dim qi As Integer
Dim calcKwp As Double
Dim calcArea As Integer

Sub Form_Load()
    grow = 0
    hot = 0
    qi = 0
    cboRegion.ListIndex = 0
    cboDept.ListIndex = 0
    Recalc
    ShowQuote
    DrawChart
    StartTimer 40
End Sub

' ---------- one timer drives all animation (40 ms) ----------
Sub Form_Timer()
    ticks = ticks + 1
    If grow < 1 Then
        grow = grow + 0.04
        If grow > 1 Then grow = 1
        DrawChart
    End If
    Stat1.Advance
    Stat2.Advance
    Stat3.Advance
    Stat4.Advance
    If ticks Mod 150 = 0 Then NextQuote
End Sub

' ---------- bar chart on the canvas ----------
Function Installs(i As Integer) As Double
    Select Case i
        Case 1
            Return 1.2
        Case 2
            Return 1.9
        Case 3
            Return 2.6
        Case 4
            Return 3.4
        Case 5
            Return 4.5
        Case Else
            Return 5.8
    End Select
End Function

Function YearOf(i As Integer) As Integer
    Return 2018 + i
End Function

Sub DrawChart()
    Dim i As Integer
    Dim bx As Integer
    Dim bh As Double
    cvChart.Clear
    cvChart.DrawColor = "#5f86a8"
    cvChart.DrawLine 4, 200, 476, 200
    For i = 1 To 6
        bx = 14 + (i - 1) * 78
        bh = Installs(i) * 28 * grow
        If i = hot Then
            cvChart.DrawColor = "#ffe08a"
        Else
            cvChart.DrawColor = "#ffb400"
        End If
        cvChart.FillRect bx, 200 - bh, 52, bh
        cvChart.DrawColor = "#cfe3f5"
        cvChart.DrawText YearOf(i), bx + 9, 208
    Next
End Sub

Sub cvChart_MouseMove()
    Dim i As Integer
    i = Int((cvChart.MouseX - 14) / 78) + 1
    If i < 1 Or i > 6 Then i = 0
    If i <> hot Then
        hot = i
        DrawChart
        If hot > 0 Then lblChartInfo.Caption = YearOf(hot) & ": " & Installs(hot) & " MWp installed" Else lblChartInfo.Caption = "Hover a bar for details"
    End If
End Sub

Sub btnReplay_Click()
    grow = 0
    hot = 0
    lblChartInfo.Caption = "Hover a bar for details"
    Stat1.Replay
    Stat2.Replay
    Stat3.Replay
    Stat4.Replay
End Sub

' ---------- solar calculator ----------
Function RegionYield() As Integer
    Select Case cboRegion.ListIndex
        Case 0
            Return 1050
        Case 1
            Return 1100
        Case 2
            Return 1150
        Case Else
            Return 1000
    End Select
End Function

' 12450 -> "12 450"
Function Grouped(v As Double) As String
    Dim t As Long
    Dim r As Integer
    t = Round(v, 0)
    If t < 1000 Then Return t
    r = t Mod 1000
    Return Int(t / 1000) & " " & Right("00" & r, 3)
End Function

Sub Recalc()
    Dim area As Integer
    Dim kwp As Double
    Dim kwh As Double
    Dim selfUse As Double
    Dim saving As Double
    Dim cost As Double
    Dim payback As Double
    area = 20 + sldArea.Value
    kwp = Round(area / 6.5, 1)
    kwh = kwp * RegionYield()
    selfUse = 0.35
    cost = kwp * 1650
    If chkBattery.Checked Then
        selfUse = 0.7
        cost = cost + 4800
    End If
    saving = kwh * selfUse * 0.3 + kwh * (1 - selfUse) * 0.08
    payback = cost / saving
    calcArea = area
    calcKwp = kwp
    lblAreaVal.Caption = area & " m2"
    lblSize.Caption = kwp & " kWp"
    lblYield.Caption = Grouped(kwh) & " kWh"
    lblSaving.Caption = "EUR " & Grouped(saving)
    lblPayback.Caption = Round(payback, 1) & " years"
    lblCo2.Caption = Grouped(kwh * 0.23) & " kg"
    lblCost.Caption = "EUR " & Grouped(cost)
    If payback < 10 Then lblPayback.ForeColor = "#1e8449" Else lblPayback.ForeColor = "#b9770e"
End Sub

Sub sldArea_Change()
    Recalc
End Sub

Sub cboRegion_Change()
    Recalc
End Sub

Sub chkBattery_Change()
    Recalc
End Sub

Sub btnUseCalc_Click()
    ContactForm1.Topic = "Quote for a " & calcKwp & " kWp system (" & calcArea & " m2)"
    lblCalcNote.Caption = "Added to the contact form at the bottom of the page."
End Sub

' ---------- testimonial slider ----------
Function QuoteText(i As Integer) As String
    Select Case i
        Case 0
            Return "We cut our electricity bill by two thirds, and the team was on our roof within a week."
        Case 1
            Return "Planning, subsidy paperwork, installation: one contact person for everything. Exactly what a farm needs."
        Case 2
            Return "Our 180 kWp carport system paid for itself faster than the calculation promised."
        Case Else
            Return "Eight years on, the monitoring still tells me about a problem before I notice it."
    End Select
End Function

Function QuoteWho(i As Integer) As String
    Select Case i
        Case 0
            Return "Maria H., homeowner, Klosterneuburg"
        Case 1
            Return "Josef T., farmer, Waldviertel"
        Case 2
            Return "Dr. Elena K., managing director, Graz"
        Case Else
            Return "Peter and Anna S., Salzburg"
    End Select
End Function

Function Dots(i As Integer) As String
    Dim s As String
    Dim k As Integer
    s = ""
    For k = 0 To 3
        If k = i Then s = s & "● " Else s = s & "○ "
    Next
    Return s
End Function

Sub ShowQuote()
    lblQuote.Caption = QuoteText(qi)
    lblWho.Caption = QuoteWho(qi)
    lblDots.Caption = Dots(qi)
End Sub

Sub NextQuote()
    qi = (qi + 1) Mod 4
    ticks = 1
    ShowQuote
End Sub

Sub btnNext_Click()
    NextQuote
End Sub

Sub btnPrev_Click()
    qi = (qi + 3) Mod 4
    ticks = 1
    ShowQuote
End Sub

Function Hit(t As String, b As String, q As String) As Boolean
    Return InStr(LCase(t & " " & b), q) > 0
End Function

Sub txtSearch_Change()
    Dim q As String
    Dim n As Integer
    q = LCase(Trim(txtSearch.Text))
    Svc1.Visible = Hit(Svc1.Title, Svc1.Body, q)
    Svc2.Visible = Hit(Svc2.Title, Svc2.Body, q)
    Svc3.Visible = Hit(Svc3.Title, Svc3.Body, q)
    Svc4.Visible = Hit(Svc4.Title, Svc4.Body, q)
    Svc5.Visible = Hit(Svc5.Title, Svc5.Body, q)
    Svc6.Visible = Hit(Svc6.Title, Svc6.Body, q)
    n = 0
    If Svc1.Visible Then n = n + 1
    If Svc2.Visible Then n = n + 1
    If Svc3.Visible Then n = n + 1
    If Svc4.Visible Then n = n + 1
    If Svc5.Visible Then n = n + 1
    If Svc6.Visible Then n = n + 1
    lblMatches.Caption = n & " of 6 services"
End Sub

' ---------- team filter ----------
Function ShowDept(d As String) As Boolean
    Return (cboDept.Text = "Everyone") Or (cboDept.Text = d)
End Function

Sub cboDept_Change()
    Team1.Visible = ShowDept(Team1.Dept)
    Team2.Visible = ShowDept(Team2.Dept)
    Team3.Visible = ShowDept(Team3.Dept)
    Team4.Visible = ShowDept(Team4.Dept)
    Team5.Visible = ShowDept(Team5.Dept)
    Team6.Visible = ShowDept(Team6.Dept)
    Team7.Visible = ShowDept(Team7.Dept)
    Team8.Visible = ShowDept(Team8.Dept)
End Sub

pv.bio: Founded Sonnenfeld in 2009 after ten years in grid engineering. Still joins the first roof survey of every big project.
Designs our PV and storage systems. Believes a good plan is one the installer never has to question.
Has mounted more than 400 roofs and still prefers the view from the top. Trains our apprentices.
Explains subsidies in plain German, English and Hungarian, and never says “it depends” without saying on what.
Keeps scaffolding, cranes, inspectors and customers in the same week. Her spreadsheets are famous.
Talks to grid operators so you do not have to. Knows every form number by heart.
Answers the 24 h hotline on weekends and drives a van full of spare inverters.
Reads your system's data every morning and calls you before a fault becomes a problem.

pv.question: How long does an installation take?
pv.answer: Most homes need one or two days on the roof. From signed offer to grid connection it is usually six to ten weeks, mostly waiting for the grid operator.

pv.question: Is there a subsidy?
pv.answer: Yes, federal and regional programmes exist. We check your eligibility and prepare the application with you; it is included in our price.

pv.question: What happens in winter or when it rains?
pv.answer: Panels still deliver 10 to 25 percent of their peak power on cloudy days. Your grid connection covers the rest, a battery bridges the evening.

pv.question: What if something breaks?
pv.answer: You get a 25-year performance warranty on modules, 10 years on inverters and a service hotline that answers within 24 hours.

' StatCounter component: counts up to Target when the page calls Advance
' Properties: Target, Suffix, Legend
Dim shown As Integer

Sub Legend_Change()
    lblLegend.Caption = Legend
End Sub

Sub Suffix_Change()
    lblNum.Caption = shown & Suffix
End Sub

Public Sub Advance()
    Dim stp As Integer
    If shown >= Target Then Exit Sub
    stp = Int(Target / 60) + 1
    shown = shown + stp
    If shown > Target Then shown = Target
    lblNum.Caption = shown & Suffix
End Sub

Public Sub Replay()
    shown = 0
    lblNum.Caption = shown & Suffix
End Sub

Public Function IsDone() As Boolean
    Return shown >= Target
End Function

Public Sub Collapse()
    isOpen = False
    Me.Height = 56
    btnQ.Caption = "+   " & Question
End Sub

Sub btnQ_Click()
    If isOpen Then
        Collapse
    Else
        isOpen = True
        Me.Height = 136
        btnQ.Caption = "-   " & Question
        RaiseEvent Opened
    End If
End Sub

' ContactForm component
' Property: Topic     Event: Submitted(who)
Public Event Submitted(who)

Sub Form_Load()
    lblCount.Caption = "0 / 400"
    lblStatus.Caption = ""
End Sub

Sub Topic_Change()
    txtTopic.Text = Topic
End Sub

Sub txtMessage_Change()
    lblCount.Caption = Len(txtMessage.Text) & " / 400"
    If Len(txtMessage.Text) > 400 Then lblCount.ForeColor = "#c0392b" Else lblCount.ForeColor = "#6b7c8d"
End Sub

' returns "" when everything is fine, otherwise the first problem
Function Problem() As String
    If Len(Trim(txtName.Text)) < 2 Then Return "Please enter your name."
    If InStr(txtEmail.Text, "@") < 2 Or InStr(txtEmail.Text, ".") = 0 Then Return "Please enter a valid e-mail address."
    If Len(Trim(txtMessage.Text)) < 10 Then Return "Please describe your project in a few words."
    If Len(txtMessage.Text) > 400 Then Return "Your message is longer than 400 characters."
    If Not chkConsent.Checked Then Return "Please tick the consent box."
    Return ""
End Function

Sub btnSend_Click()
    Dim msg As String
    msg = Problem()
    If msg <> "" Then
        lblStatus.ForeColor = "#c0392b"
        lblStatus.Caption = "Not sent: " & msg
        Exit Sub
    End If
    lblStatus.ForeColor = "#1e8449"
    lblStatus.Caption = "Thank you! We will answer within one working day."
    RaiseEvent Submitted(Trim(txtName.Text))
    txtMessage.Clear
    lblCount.Caption = "0 / 400"
End Sub
